title: Downloaded from misleading ad
body: There absolutely no feature on the app that shows “what the pilot’s seeing right now”. The app doesn’t even show major international flights. Totally misleading ads. Do not recommend this app.

title: FB Ad is BS
body: The add in FB says you can hear ATC and see virtual cockpit views. Both are a lie. Paid $60 for something worse than FlightView and FlightAware. What a rip off.

title: Review
body: This app is worthless. It is ad after ad. Can’t even enjoy watching someone’s flight because ads play constantly. Would not recommend.

title: Not accurate

title: Caution when ordering
body: I reviewed the plans and they had a 50% off plan for $24.95. I first clicked on the try it now plan, but thought I would go ahead and get the deal. Once I downloaded the app I instantly realized this app was not for me. I could get the screen to show active flights. Each flight froze on the screen. It didn’t show my location on the screen either. I am not happy with the app and canceled it immediately. I tried to contact them by clicking on contact me which wanted me to download an email app instead of showing me the email address to contact them. I would like my money back. Follow up response was: I received an email from the creator of the app (through Apple) asking me to contact them for help. I had already contacted them and received my money back. Their response seemed like months later. I am not sure of the date of this review, but I’m not too impressed.
